approval_required_for: Any change to numeric precision, quantization intent, or numeric policy.
Any addition, replacement, or major modification of a template or its supported parameter contract.
Any change to architecture/design-space constraints or material resource assumptions.

executable_actions.on_failure: Record each checker result and the specific unresolved binding or unsupported claim in the expected artifacts; keep SACG extraction and template-constrained architecture planning blocked on failing or not_run required checks. Do not repair RTL, invent template support, or alter numeric policy. Route any proposed numeric-policy, template, architecture, or resource-assumption change for approval.
executable_actions.rationale: Establish whether the supplied numeric policy and template-constrained design-space contract are traceable and statically supported. The current summary contains artifact-presence evidence only, so checker results must be obtained before promotion.

observations: The state summary lists all four in-scope artifacts as inputs; the candidate summary does not expose their contents or any results from numeric_policy_check, template_coverage_check, parameter_binding_static_check, or template_binding_static_check.

The visible design_space key summary includes hard_constraints, objectives, qor_targets, and notes, but not their values; this is not evidence that a particular resource bound or parameter binding is present or absent.

No current SACG-memory contamination barriers or open retry/backtrack requests are reported.
proposed_actions: Run the registered numeric and template static checkers on the four supplied artifacts and record checker-grounded results in the expected audit and binding-gap artifacts.

Hand off unresolved bindings and any cross-layer inconsistencies to the cross-layer readiness auditor; do not change numeric policy, select unsupported templates, or claim implementation/resource results.
